glossary.ja: ウイングガンダムゼロ
glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing / Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Heero's Gundam (XXXG-00W0) with the ZERO System and Twin Buster Rifle
Drake Luft's flagship aura battleship; an enemy ship in Operation 25.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Final Tallgeese variant (OZ-00MS2B) with a Mega Cannon, piloted by Zechs in Endless Waltz
Domon's second Mobile Fighter (GF13-017NJII), Neo Japan; God Finger and Hyper Mode (Meikyo Shisui)
Nergal mass-produced mecha; used alone and in エステバリス隊 (Aestivalis squad/team).
Bright Noa's flagship, dotless spelling used in m6900.
Daba's white A-class Heavy Metal, a Yaman-built mecha. Later piloted by Amu.

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam Wing: Endless Waltz
glossary.role: Mass-produced heavy-firepower mobile suit (MMS-01) of the Mariemaia Army
The three D-series prototype Metal Armors (D-1, D-2, D-3), also called D-weapons
Sho's upgraded, transformable Aura Battler from the Kingdom of Na; Sho's playable unit in ACE2 (also a camouflage-color version)
SPT-LZ-00X, Eiji's experimental Grados SPT with the AI 'Rei' and the V-MAX system.
Main antagonist; Lord of House Luft in the Kingdom of Ah (アの国), who summons Holy Warriors and wages war to unite Byston Well; commands the Will Wipps
glossary.personality: Ambitious, scheming warlord who believes his conquest is justified. Loves his daughter Riml but is blind to the plots around him.

glossary.role: Female lead; heir of the Sanc Kingdom (real name Relena Peacecraft), Zechs's younger sister, and a pacifist leader.
glossary.personality: Idealistic, determined pacifist; dignified and unafraid to confront soldiers.

glossary.role: Title given to surface-world (地上人) pilots summoned to Byston Well; also part of the series title 聖戦士ダンバイン.

glossary.note: Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

rows.jp: できるだけ多くの敵機を撃破
rows.en: Destroy As Many Enemy Units As Possible

rows.jp: ウイングガンダムゼロに勝利
エステバリス（アキト）に勝利
ゴッドガンダムに勝利
エステバリス３機に勝利
ウィル・ウィプスの撃沈
<op()><sp(20)>ターゲットは点在する貯蔵庫だ<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>The targets are the scattered storage depots.<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <sp(20)>格納されているのは敵の機密物資らしい<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <sp(20)>They appear to house enemy classified supplies.<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <sp(20)>なんとしても全ての貯蔵庫を<ab(1500)>
<op()><sp(20)>敵は逃走の準備を進めている<ab(2000)>
<sp(20)>急いで全て貯蔵庫を破壊してくれ<ab(2000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>目標の位置情報をそちらに転送した<ab(2000)>
<sp(20)>貯蔵庫は矢印の示す方向にあるぞ<ab(2000)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Depots lie in the directions indicated by arrows.<ab(2000)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>全ての貯蔵庫の破壊を確認<ab(2000)>
<sp(20)>敵基地も沈黙したようだな<ab(2000)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>Looks like the enemy base was silenced too.<ab(2000)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>よし、各機ラーカイラムに戻れ<ab(2500)><ed()>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>All right, all units return to Ra Cailum.<ab(2500)><ed()>

rows.jp: <sp(20)>これは・・・戦艦ウィル・ウィプスです！<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>おのれの力の無さを知るがいい<ab(1000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>Know the depth of your own powerlessness.<ab(1000)>

rows.jp: <sp(20)>地上人の聖戦士など不要だということを<ab(0)>
rows.en: <sp(20)>That Holy Warriors from the Upper World are unnecessary,<ab(0)>
<sp(20)>I shall prove it here and now!<ab(1000)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>ウィル・ウィプスの破壊を確認！<ab(2000)>
<sp(20)>各機、ラーカイラムに帰還しろ…<ab(2000)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>All units, return to the Ra Cailum...<ab(2000)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>このままでは戦線が維持できない<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>At this rate we cannot hold the battle line.<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <sp(20)>敵戦艦の撃破を急いでくれ･･･！<ab(2000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(20)>作戦領域の南より新たな熱源反応！<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>New thermal contact south of the operation area!<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>作戦領域の東より新たな熱源反応！<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>New thermal contact east of the operation area!<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>作戦領域の北より新たな熱源反応！<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>New thermal contact north of the operation area!<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <sp(20)>各機、ラーカイラムに帰還しろ・・・！<ab(2000)><ed()>
rows.en: <sp(20)>All units, return to the Ra Cailum...!<ab(2000)><ed()>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>Ｅ戦区の戦線が崩壊した模様！<ab(2000)>
rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>The front line in Sector E has collapsed!<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>敵機影確認。識別コードありません<ab(2000)><off()>
<on()><sp(20)>戦艦クラスの熱源反応を確認<ab(500)>
<on()><sp(20)>ドレイクだけを倒せばすむなどとは思わせん<ab(500)>
rows.en: <on()><sp(20)>Do not think defeating Drake alone suffices.<ab(500)>

rows.jp: <on()><sp(20)>くそっ。いてぇーじゃねーかよ<ab(500)><off()>

<on()><sp(20)>ぐっ…、ここまでが
生身のパイロットの限界というわけか<ab(2000)>
rows.en:
<on()><sp(20)>Guh... is this the limit of a
flesh-and-blood pilot?<ab(2000)>

rows.jp:
<sp(20)>強くなったなリリーナ、
それでこそピースクラフト家の娘だ<ab(2000)>
rows.en:
<sp(20)>You have grown strong, Relena,
truly a daughter of the Peacecraft family.<ab(2000)>

rows.jp:
<sp(20)>お前ならきっと、父上の理想とした国を
導いてゆけるはずだ<ab(2000)>
rows.en:
<sp(20)>You will surely guide the nation
our father envisioned.<ab(2000)>

rows.jp: <op()><sp(20)>すごいプレッシャーだ、気をつけろ<ab(1000)><ed()>

rows.en: <op()><sp(20)>The Nu Gundam is not just for show!<ab(1000)><ed()>
<op()><sp(100)>Ruri Hoshino test string destroy defend burst<ab(5000)><ed()>

report.translator_summary: Group xd batch xd_01 translated. Covers Extra duel mission titles (m6340..m6361), storage depot assault and Will Wips ambush (m6900), Endless Waltz extra mission (m6905), and developer test strings (m6901, m6998).
